submitted.rationale: All five EQE measurements across the Sb fraction range 0.22–0.80 are near zero (≤0.0017%), which fits wide-gap Zn–Sb oxides (for example, ZnSb2O6 and Zn7Sb2O12 have experimental gaps of about 3.3 eV or more) that absorb little at 2.4 eV. Index 10 (Sb 0.49) gave the highest measured value, 0.00169%. It is only slightly above the others, and the differences are probably within noise.
